carrier.transform: spatial sign carrier; existing SemBind project adapter unchanged

limitations: Working Gaussian channel and semantic posterior independence can be misspecified
Temperature scaling and Gaussian soft decoding are prior art; grouped constant-semantic evidence was already explored in this project
The candidate tests query-dependent semantic uncertainty at the shared-bit level; novelty and benefit are not established
Twelve hand-written held-out sources, not paper-scale confirmation
Source-shared coordinates and repeated covers are dependent; zero counts do not prove extremely low FPR
Calibrated scores may weaken forgery rejection; all full published endpoints execute regardless of genuine results
Baseline process receives public images, not verifier keys; same-account directories are not an OS sandbox
independent_audit: All default BA values independently recomputed; candidate and constant grouped scores independently checked in probability space; complete combinations and hashes checked

decoder.training: Only six prior full-carrier sources; global linear Gaussian channel gain/variance and a single positive semantic temperature
decoder.calibration: Separate six prior sources; each calibrated score uses the fourth smallest of60 genuine values (>=), targeting at least57/60
decoder.score_probability_claim: Composite likelihood under working assumptions, not a calibrated p-value or security bound
decoder.group_information_bound: Each semantic bit contributes at most log2 under the stated ideal likelihood model

execution.completion_mode: Child-exit events: extract -> fit/calibrate/freeze -> full genuine -> audit -> full unchanged Imprint -> all-checkpoint verification -> independent score audit and analysis
